Commonly used in the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing industry, the '''T-44 power-shunt''' was a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] produced by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a set of T-44 power-shunts were planted in the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] of [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] during a state visit to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. The bomb [[Assassination of Aks Moe|detonated]] while the airspeeder was traveling along an [[Expressway (Aargau)|expressway]] on Aargau, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Moe and three of his companions. It remained unknown following Moe's assassination who exactly had placed the power-shunts inside the airspeeder, but many believed that the attack was linked to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Description==
The T-44 power-shunt was a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] produced by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]], a subsidiary of [[Baktoid Industries/Legends|Baktoid Industries]], during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. T-44 power-shunts were commonly utilized in the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing industry, but were also used as weapons against other beings. A set of T-44 power-shunts were sufficiently powerful enough to obliterate an entire [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] and a large portion of the area around it. The bomb could also be equipped with a rare [[Protein/Legends|protein]] based triggering mechanism that could target a specific individual's [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] and detonate when said individual was in close proximity to the power-shunt.

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], a set of T-44 power-shunts were placed in the airspeeder of [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]]&mdash;a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] and member of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]&mdash;during a state visit to the [[Bank/Legends|banking]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. Moe, a pair of [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] servants, and a traveling companion of Moe's boarded the airspeeder during the visit to journey to the [[Commodities Exchange Cathedral]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[New Escrow]]. However, as the airspeeder merged onto an [[Expressway (Aargau)|expressway]], the power-shunts triggered, overloading the speeder's [[Power core/Legends|power plant]], and causing the speeder to [[Assassination of Aks Moe|explode]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] everyone inside.
